title: Cranberry Russian Cabbage Borscht
description: A lighthearted twist on traditional Russian borscht, featuring the sweetness of cranberry juice and the crunch of fresh cabbage.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the grated carrot and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly softened.
Add the shredded cabbage and cook until it starts to wilt, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated beetroot, cranberry juice, tomato paste (if using), and salt-free seasoning blend.
Stir to combine, then add the apple cider vinegar.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until the cabbage is tender.
Season with additional salt-free seasoning blend to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
Serve in individual ramekins and enjoy!
